goal: MoE W2 PTX + graph-only dispatch unlock

attempts.title: CPU environment, source, ABI and negative-evidence audit
attempts.hypothesis: The prior campaign's signed identity is still exact for the current source, so stock/candidate bundles can be reused instead of rebuilt.
attempts.evidence: READY 17a5e23c0bd3cac16d88a1054047c4488fd9ca46b34fcca25560f83fdca7858b re-verified with zero drift; stock BM128/stage-8 and candidate BM16/stage-12 confirmed for expected-M 4/5/8/9; DSO 395655ab609ef5037fe3bb93f4a2d813c047f1265fd5f30554948dd8d0e51780; no spills, no local memory, identical launch topology.
attempts.notes: Explicitly records stock as BM128/stage-8, so the invalidated Task-26 stage-11 premise is not reused. Avoided a rebuild that would have grown cache against a 12-13 GiB free-disk margin.

attempts.title: Graph-only dispatch for the W2 hotspot entry
attempts.hypothesis: The prior 0.80x selected eager leaf was the API-v1 Python provider tax, not the kernel. Restricting selection to CUDA graph capture keeps eager on stock and lets the device win survive.
attempts.delta: SGLang: KernelSpec.graph_only on moe_down_proj only; config.graph_only_enabled with SGLANG_GLM52_W2_GRAPH_ONLY default on; try_dispatch_moe_masked declines before the ABI check and before the hit/miss lock when not capturing.
attempts.evidence: 5 CPU contract tests; GPU contract status=pass: eager 0 provider attempts with output untouched, capture selects exactly one candidate node, captured graph identical with graph-only on and off, eager containing identity lane estimators 0.9987-1.0068 with 0 provider attempts.
attempts.notes: This is the plan's required integration and it works. It is retained even though the candidate it unblocks does not pass.

attempts.title: BM16-auto candidate under graph-only gates
attempts.hypothesis: With the provider tax removed, BM16's reduced output traffic clears 1.03 on both graph leaf and graph containing region for all four expected-M hints.
attempts.delta: none to the kernel; measurement under the graph-only policy
attempts.evidence: Graph leaf passes 3/3 series for every hint, worst estimator 1.08457-1.09585. Graph containing region fails for every hint: worst estimators 1.02638 (em4), 1.02719 (em5), 1.02810 (em8), 1.02563 (em9); em9 fails all three series.
attempts.notes: Leaf is a development gate only. The region saves ~6.4 us on a ~219 us denominator, which lands on the 1.03 threshold, so per-series spread decides each result.

attempts.title: PTX hypothesis 1: reduce padded TMEM/output stores for exact expected-M
attempts.hypothesis: Further trimming padded output/TMEM stores buys the ~2.5 us the containing region needs.
attempts.evidence: NCU w2_em4.ncu-rep: candidate DRAM write is already 4.60 MB against stock's 40.07 MB, and the exact-valid-row floor is 1.573 MB. The whole remaining write surplus is 3.03 MB, worth 0.501 us at the measured 6.043 TB/s, i.e. 0.23% on the region.
attempts.notes: Quantified ceiling is an order of magnitude below the requirement. Building it would confirm arithmetic at the cost of GPU time and cache growth.

attempts.title: PTX hypothesis 2: narrow PTX scheduling / barrier overlap on the BM16 pipeline
attempts.hypothesis: Barrier or TMA-issue scheduling is leaving microseconds on the table in the BM16 pipeline.
attempts.evidence: NCU: stock and candidate both sustain ~6.05 TB/s DRAM, so duration equals bytes moved divided by a bandwidth the candidate already matches. Issue slots 5.49% busy, 0 spill bytes, 0 local memory, 43 registers: the kernel is neither issue-bound nor barrier-bound. Reads are 406.91 MB against an irreducible 402.65 MB of weights (ratio 1.0106). Shared memory is 230188 B of a ~228 KiB cap, so deeper prefetch is unavailable.
attempts.notes: The plan requires a concrete SASS defect and a predicted instruction/stall change before inline PTX. No such defect exists: the candidate is at 99.26% of its achievable DRAM floor with 0.501 us of total headroom.

attempts.title: Harness auditor edge-phase model did not cover the containing region
attempts.hypothesis: The first region lane's audit failure is a latent harness contract defect, not a measurement problem.
attempts.delta: audit_result.py and test_contract_v2.py derive the expected phase set from the same predicate the runner uses for W2 edge-mask validation (leaf and region).
attempts.evidence: Runner validates edge masks for family in {moe_grouped_masked, moe_compute_region}; auditor expected them only for moe_grouped_masked. No region lane had been run before, so the mismatch was latent.
attempts.notes: Three unrelated test_contract_v2.py failures remain and are pre-existing at the parent commit (legacy Task-26 artifact directory absent from this worktree).

not_expanded.reason: The containing-region gate fails for all four expected-M hints and the roofline ceiling shows no bounded kernel change can close it.
